branchRationale: Host is Apple M4 Pro, 24 GiB unified memory (sysctl hw.memsize=25769803776). mlx-lm ships native support for the target architecture (mlx_lm/models/granitemoehybrid.py present in 0.31.3), so a local QLoRA smoke run on the 4-bit MLX weights is feasible (peak ~9.86 GB during training). Branch (a) taken and completed.

target.archNote: Mamba-2 / Transformer hybrid (non-standard-attention), confirmed live from ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro/config.json: model_type=granitemoehybrid, architectures=[GraniteMoeHybridForCausalLM], 40 layers, hidden_size 2048.

trainingCheckpoint.reason: mlx-lm LoRA needs an MLX-layout checkpoint of the SAME model. This is the official mlx-community 4-bit MLX conversion of the stick default (Apache-2.0). QLoRA (LoRA over 4-bit frozen base) keeps peak memory ~9.9 GB.

framework.archSupportVerifiedLive: GitHub ml-explore/mlx-lm mlx_lm/models/ listing on 2026-07-03 shows granite.py, granitemoehybrid.py, mamba.py, mamba2.py, rwkv7.py. The installed 0.31.3 wheel contains mlx_lm/models/granitemoehybrid.py; training loaded the model as granitemoehybrid and ran without arch errors.
framework.transformersPinReason: mlx-lm 0.31.3 declares transformers>=5.0.0, but transformers 5.13.0 breaks the mlx_lm import (AutoTokenizer.register('NewlineTokenizer', ...) raises AttributeError). Pinned to 4.57.1, verified working end-to-end (train + fuse + generate) on 2026-07-04. Documented in requirements.txt.

mergeConvert.mergeResult: OK - adapter fused into MLX base weights -> training/fused_model/
mergeConvert.ggufExportError: mlx_lm fuse --export-gguf raises: 'Model type granitemoehybrid not supported for GGUF conversion.' (mlx_lm gguf exporter supports only llama/mixtral/mistral-family, and cannot export quantized source weights).
mergeConvert.workingConvertPath: Off-site: fuse the adapter into the ORIGINAL fp16/bf16 HF checkpoint, then llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf.py + llama-quantize Q4_K_M. Needs ~13 GB scratch; blocked locally by the disk gate. See REMOTE_RECIPE.md.

eval.note: Pipeline proof only. 20 held-out medqa_jp items (from END of corpus, disjoint from train/valid), greedy decode. No quality bar - a 15-step adapter on 48 examples cannot move real accuracy; real gains need the hospital gold set + off-site GPU SFT, then m7 bake-off + m9 re-validation.

rwkv7Alternative.note: The PRIMARY stick model RWKV-7 World 2.9B (arch rwkv7) is fine-tuned via its NATIVE trainer BlinkDL/RWKV-LM (state-tuning / LoRA / full SFT in PyTorch+CUDA), NOT mlx-lm's generic LoRA. mlx-lm does ship mlx_lm/models/rwkv7.py for inference/LoRA, but the reference RWKV-LM recipe is the documented path. See README_TRAINING.md 'RWKV-7 alternative' and REMOTE_RECIPE.md.
